title: Digital Librarianship
definition: The practice of connecting individuals and information resources, understanding visitor needs, and facilitating knowledge acquisition and understanding.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a librarian as your personal guide. They help you find the right book or article, even when you don't know what you're looking for.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A digital librarian is a search engine plus a therapist plus a teacher. They understand your needs beyond the words. They connect you to resources you didn't know existed.
difficulty_levels.expert: Digital librarianship is the emergent property of the mycelium network. It's about connecting nodes and edges to create knowledge. The library is not just a repository; it's a dynamic system that grows and adapts to meet visitor needs.

extra_fields.insight: The most valuable skill for a digital librarian is listening. Knowing what the visitor really needs, beyond the surface words.
